# `remesh.isotropic`: Isotropic remesh

Rebuilds a mesh as even triangles about `edge` long (valence near 6), keeping boundaries and sharp features.

- Category: remesh
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(iterations x T log T) for T output triangles
- Flags: undoable, long_running
- Also known as: isotropic remesh, uniform remesh, triangle remesh, even triangles, remesh

Edges longer than 4/3 of `edge` are split, shorter than 4/5 collapsed, edges flipped toward valence 6, and vertices relaxed in their tangent planes and projected back onto the original surface, `iterations` times (Botsch and Kobbelt 2004). Boundaries and edges bent more than `feature_angle` stay put, so hard-surface edges survive. Open meshes work. `quads` joins triangle pairs into a quad-dominant mesh afterwards. Face groups and materials carry over by the nearest old face.

**Use for** evening out scans, booleans and decimated meshes before sculpting, deformation or simulation; `remesh.quad` makes all-quad, flow-aligned topology for organic parts.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edge` | `Length \| null` | - | Target edge length; about a fortieth of the largest side when omitted. |
| `feature_angle` | `Angle` | `40.0` | Edges bent more than this are features and keep their place. |
| `iterations` | `number` | `6` | Rounds of split, collapse, flip, relax and project. |
| `quads` | `boolean` | `false` | Join triangle pairs into quads afterwards (quad-dominant). |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"edge":"5cm","target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): remeshed into 3,072 faces (3,072 tris), edges about 50 mm`
